terms.comment: Our phrase, testing by hand, set against automated testing: Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for manual testing. Probātiō is the lexicon’s word for testing (see testing), and manuālis, of or for the hand, is mostly post-Augustan (Tac., Plin., in Lewis & Short).

sources: Lewis & Short: probatio. Dictionary links support the component words; the modern technical expressions are labelled separately.
